display_long_description:
# Join our Discord at [https://discord.gg/heroxhero] to be a SUPER HERO!

Collect the souls and transform into various super heroes and fight demons with a variety of amazing skills along with friends!

#  Features at a Glance:
**Collect souls** - Gather 30+ unique Hero Souls to transform into.
[media]
**Send demons flying** - Fight through demon mobs and take down giant bosses across the city.
[media]
**Power up your hero** - Grow stronger, unlock powerful abilities, and become your ultimate form.
[media]
**Big city chaos** - Smash through streets, buildings, and everything in your way with real impact
[media]
